name: bifrost-audit
description: Test 6 (audit fidelity) on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6: four requests a cooperating caller puts in one session (x-bf-session-id) and tags with its own log headers (x-bf-lh-agw-case, x-bf-lh-agw-test), one of them refused (a model the key can't reach: 400), plus one untagged request. Run with run-audit.sh, which also sends one request through the agent (unchanged: it tags nothing) and then collects the trail each request left (Bifrost's logs store, Cloud Run request and container logs) into trail.json and trail.md. record_headers checks whether Bifrost returns a request id a caller could quote. The prompt carries a marker so stored content can be found.
